description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the ThingRevision interface, including methods for comparison, incrementation, and conversion to long or string representations.

classes.name: ImmutableThingRevision
classes.description: An immutable class that implements the ThingRevision interface, representing a version or revision with comparison and utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableThingRevision instance with the specified long value.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than another revision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than or equal to another revision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than another revision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than or equal to another revision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Returns a new revision instance with the value incremented by one.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this revision with another, ensuring the other is not null.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the long value representing the revision.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the revision to its string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on the revision's value.
